title: Conceptual Coherence
definition: The consistency and logical coherence of a set of concepts within a domain.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Conceptual coherence is like making sure all the pieces of a puzzle fit together smoothly.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Conceptual coherence is achieved when concepts are defined clearly and consistently.
difficulty_levels.expert: Conceptual coherence is a critical aspect of philosophical inquiry and epistemology.

extra_fields.insight: Achieving conceptual coherence requires a deep understanding of the nature of concepts and logical consistency.
